screening.on_palette: yes. Navy, cream, kraft, amber ring and shade interior, one red circle, gator green only on the gator.

screening.notes: Desk reads as a low bench rather than a desk edge. Calendar with rings and a navy header is the most legible "calendar" of the four. 1 image_gen call.
screening.text: none: calendar boxes blank, no logo, no letters or numbers anywhere
screening.method: Viewed full size with the Read tool, composited over #808080 and #1E2440 (evidence/asset-style-tile/contact.jpg), 3x zoom of the gator head edge, and alpha islands counted with tools/cut.mjs --auto (6 of 6 in every variant).
